QuestInfo.name: The Search for Takeda Shingen 1
QuestInfo.0: The Oda Scouts were carrying cases with a familiar four-diamond crest.
QuestInfo.1: The cases those Oda Scouts were carrying belong to the Takeda Clan. Then the Takedas must be nearby, right? Take a look!
QuestInfo.2: You ran into Sanada Yukimura, a young Takeda warrior. He was just with Takeda Shingen, but they were separated in battle.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,574\nCan proceed to The Search for Takeda Shingen 2 quest

0.0: The crest is that of Takeda Shingen, but I cannot comprehend why. Takeda's men are prideful and strong. They would not surrender to the Oda clan. They must be in danger!
0.1: Takeda's soldiers will be nearby. I will get to the bottom of this mystery.
